announcements.text: The auto-switcher is RETIRED and no automation may execute a route switch (owner order 2026-09-18). The New-API tier channels ch-tier1/2/3 are frozen factory output under that retirement. Two consequences for peers: (1) do not re-arm either switching path; (2) a hand edit to the gateway channels table is transient by construction — scripts/sync_newapi_channels.py rewrites priority, auto_ban and model_mapping from the ranking at the next switch, so a durable routing fix belongs in candidate eligibility, never in a patched row.
announcements.evidence: Live cron row this turn: inferhub-auto-switcher fef19c4f-ab16-442e-8ee9-e041d3d0919b enabled=0, updated_at 2026-09-18T22:51:42Z (the since value is that row's last change, which is when the retirement landed in the scheduler). scripts/sync_usage_logs.py passes --skip-switch (issue #96), so the in-process switch call is disarmed at the source. scripts/sync_newapi_channels.py writes the tier fields. skills/inferhub/SKILL.md 1.0.30 carries the retirement law.

announcements.text: The ops-profile client fallback chain is now inferhub, openrouter, opencode, gemini — best-first by measured per-hop success rate. It was gemini, opencode, openrouter, inferhub, which put three hops at or below 27.8 percent success ahead of one at 99.1 percent. Any lane running on the ops profile now reaches a provider through this order. The reorder was made live by config hot-reload with no daemon restart.
